snippet.title: TurretGirls - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
TurretGirls, the explosive railgun turret defense shooter, is officially available now on PC (Steam, GOG, itch.io)! Humanity’s last hope is here, and it’s packing more firepower, sass, and omurice-fueled determination than ever. 

Since the release of the TurretGirls demo, major improvements have been made to the game, including smoother framerates, increased resolution options, new features, and polished gameplay systems. The end result? A faster, flashier, and more explosive alien-splatting experience worthy of the Planetary Alien Neutralization & Tactical Strike Unit (better known as P.A.N.T.S.U.).

TurretGrils on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029750/TurretGirls/

TurretGirls is a fast-paced, on-rails turret defense shooter where you play as a lone civil servant from the elite P.A.N.T.S.U. unit, holding the line against endless alien hordes. Strap into your upgradeable turret, build generators to charge a planet-saving superweapon, and adapt on the fly as enemies swarm from every direction. With flashy firepower, cheeky humor, and performance-based gear unlocks (including tactical uniform malfunctions!), TurretGirls mixes high-octane action with anime flair.

Warning: TurretGirls contains mature themes, flashy combat, and tactical uniform malfunctions under extreme alien pressure. Viewer and player discretion is advised!

Title: TurretGirls
Developer: NANAIRO ENTERPRISE
Publisher: DANGEN Entertainment
Genre: Railgun Defense Shooter 
Players: 1
Platform: PC
Price: $9.99 USD
Release Date: August 25, 2025
Languages: English, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
